subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/state:HSD_SetupChannelMode

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/state:HSD_SetupPEMode
subjects.behavior: Non-null descriptor ignores flags and supplies all eight wrapper configurations from twelve byte fields. Null descriptor enables color, disables alpha-write/dst-alpha/dither; flag0x40000000 enables blend;0x20000000 disables depth writes;0x08000000 changes depth comparison3 to7. Late comparison with alpha tuple(4,0,0,4,0) only for blending with depth writes, else early and(7,0,0,7,0).

evidence.why: Canonical control flow and cache writes.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/state:HSD_SetupRenderMode
subjects.behavior: Finalizes HSD's current render-state batch using the supplied render-mode flags and the standard flag-derived pixel-engine configuration.
